body: Opus2 GO template correction (Fable2 #7354, 2026-11-21 22:29Z, under Greg's „NIE MA RECZNEGO HASHOWANIA”, memory greg-no-manual-hashing-2026-11-21). NEVER ask runners for "one archive with one whole-archive SHA-256" or any other manual hash. The only fingerprint allowed is the review-freeze tool's (scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs), and only where the master Test refs bullet names it: the integration owner's freeze, and the runner's before/after fingerprint on a test-ref FULL. Run evidence is the launcher's own run directory, results and source_ids, reported verbatim, plus the original files transferred as they are. My GO templates from earlier tonight (go-C7-*, go-C6-*, go-s4-*) carry the old hash line; drop it in every new GO.
